title: observability: token-level metrics/tracing, dashboard updates, and alert tuning
author: Aisha Patel
release_notes: Adds token-level cost and latency metrics, new tracing spans for request lifecycle, Grafana dashboards for token-cost/latency breakdowns, and tuned alerts to reduce false positives. No breaking changes. Rollout safe for hosted and dedicated deployments.
description: Context: Teams need better visibility into per-token cost/latency breakdowns and end-to-end tracing to diagnose regressions introduced by batching and new quantization profiles. This PR implements token-level metrics, enriched tracing spans, new Grafana dashboards, and alert threshold tuning to reduce noise. Motivation: reduce time-to-detect/diagnose performance regressions, enable cost allocation by prompt prefix, and provide clearer dashboards for SRE and product. What I changed (high level): 1) telemetry/metrics: introduced token_cost_bytes, token_latency_ms, token_generation_count and aggregated tags (model, deployment, route, pricing_tier). 2) tracing: added span names and attributes for kv-cache-hit, kv-cache-miss, batch-window, kernel-selection to make request-level traces correlate with token metrics. 3) dashboards: new dashboard JSON (observability/dashboards/token_cost_latency.json) with per-model and per-route panels, token heatmaps, and top-N prompt prefixes by cost. 4) alert tuning: adjusted the latency and cost anomaly alerts to use pct90/pct99 windows and added a sustained window to avoid spikes causing false positives. 5) docs: docs/observability/token_metrics.md describing metrics, alert rationale, and runbook. 6) tests: added integration tests that 1) validate metric labels under synthetic traffic and 2) check tracing spans are emitted for the kernel-selection path. Checklist: - [x] Metrics implemented and emitted from runtime - [x] Tracing spans added and instrumented - [x] Dashboards exported and validated with grafana-tooling - [x] Alert thresholds adjusted and smoke-tested - [x] Docs updated - [x] Unit + integration tests added Summary of commits: - feat(metrics): add token-level cost/latency metrics and aggregation - feat(tracing): add kv-cache/batching/kernel-selection spans and attributes - perf(tuning): adjust alerting rules and add sustained window - docs: add token metrics docs and dashboard export Files changed (high level): telemetry/metrics/token_metrics.go, telemetry/tracing/span_names.go, telemetry/publishers/prometheus_exporter.go, observability/dashboards/token_cost_latency.json, infra/helm/values-observability.yaml, docs/observability/token_metrics.md, tests/integration/test_token_metrics.py, examples/observability/quickstart.md, scripts/grafana/validate_dashboard.sh, ci/pipelines/integration-observability.yml, telemetry/metrics/README.md, observability/alerts/token_alerts.rules.yaml, pkg/metrics/registry.go Review notes and convo: Initial review by Marco Ruiz requested clearer metric naming and map of labels to billing keys; addressed by renaming cost_per_token -> token_cost_bytes and adding pricing_tier label. Elaine Zhang requested that alerts use pct90/pct99 and add sustained 5m window; implemented and added smoke tests. Elaine also asked for unit tests for the tracing additions; added integration test and a lightweight unit for span name constants. Priya Natarajan verified dashboard layout and approved after minor layout tweaks. CI: initial run had a flaky integration test (test_kernel_selection_trace) failing due to timing; added small backoff/retry and re-ran CI. All checks passed. Merge: squashed and merged to main on 2026-02-20. Impact and rollout: Backwards compatible metric names (old metric names are aliased for 2 weeks). No config changes required for hosted customers; dedicated customers who pin observability values should upgrade their Helm chart values (see infra/helm/values-observability.yaml). Runbook: if new alerts trigger unexpectedly, follow docs/observability/token_metrics.md runbook to correlate traces and metrics.
commits: feat(metrics): add token-level cost/latency metrics and aggregation
feat(tracing): add kv-cache/batching/kernel-selection spans and attributes
perf(tuning): adjust alerting rules and add sustained window
docs: add token metrics docs and dashboard export
review_comments: Marco Ruiz (requested changes): Please clarify metric naming and add pricing_tier label so billing teams can map metrics to invoices. Also add a table mapping metric -> label semantics.
Aisha Patel (reply): Renamed cost_per_token -> token_cost_bytes and added pricing_tier label plus docs table. PTAL.
Elaine Zhang (requested changes): Alerting: switch to pct90/pct99 and add 5m sustained window; ensure we don't regress on latency SLOs. Add unit tests for new spans.
Aisha Patel (reply): Updated alerts to use percentile windows and added smoke tests plus a unit for span names. CI flaky test fixed with retry/backoff.
Priya Natarajan (approval): Dashboards look good; small layout tweak applied. Approving for merge.
notes_on_alert_tuning: Adjusted cost-anomaly alert threshold from 30% to 50% sustained over 5m for pct90 and 30% sustained over 10m for pct99 to reduce noise from transient spikes. Added suppression rule for cache-warmup periods during deploys.
testing: integration: synthetic traffic validated token metrics under high-batch scenarios
smoke: alert firing simulation using prometheus-pusher
notes: This PR touches telemetry pipelines and alerting rules. Ops should monitor the first 48 hours after deployment for increased alert volume and coordinate with SRE on any threshold backoffs. Metrics aliases kept for backward compatibility for 2 weeks.
